translation.name: Ilagano lya Katali, Ilagano Linyale kwa Wanhu Weng’ha

content: Paoli nakawanogolela meho wala watagusa, hamba nakaluka kulonga, “Wang'holozangu, mbaka lelo hano ndali ndichikala na igano linojile hali Nguluwi.”
Aho Ananiya mtambika mkulu nakawalonjela wala wali wemile behi na Paoli wamzabule mumlomo.

Hamba Paoli nakawalonjela, “Na heye Nguluwi kokuzabula hegwe uwele unojile kwa kunze, mgati umemile wihe! Koweza ndaze kikala aho unhaguse chiutaguso na kuno hegwe gwegwe kwangubena malajizo kwa kulonga nhowigwe?”
Wanhu wali wemile hala nawamlonjela Paoli, “Hegwe kwangumliga mtambika mkulu wa Nguluwi!”
Paoli nakedichila, “Wang'holozangu, nasivizelele kota heye mtambika mkulu. Mina Maandiko gangulonga ahi, ‘Uleche kulonga vibi gala ga chilongozi wa wanhu wa hegwe.’ ”

Mhela wula Paoli naloyavizelele kuta honhu hamwe ha watagusa wala wali ndo Masadukayo na yinji Mafalisayo. Hamba nakakwiniza lizi hali watagusa, “Wang'holozangu, heni ndo Mfalisayo, mwana wa Mfalisayo. Heni ndigaligwa muutaguso kwa vila ndangitumbila kuta wabagame wozilipuka.”
Loyalonjile ago, ivuche ikali nalyaluka hewo kwa hewo. Mafalisayo na Masadukayo wala wanhu weting'hane wambuza kibagula honhu heli.
Acho chiwalo chali achi, Masadukayo wangibatilila kuta wabagame hambe wazilipuche, kuduhu wahilisi wa kilanga, na muhe kuduhu. Ila Mafalisayo wangukunda ago geng'ha gadatu.

Ivuche nalyonjezeka na wamwe wa walangusa wa malajizo ga Musa na chilundo cha Mafalisayo nawema na kulavya igayo lya hewo kwa lupichi, “Hambe tone choneche chihile mli munhu ayu, hanji muhe ama mhilisi wa kilanga nakadawala na heye!”
Kilewa nakulutilila mbaka mkulu wa chilundo nakadumba kuta Paoli yasapangwe viundeviunde. Ahyo nakawalonjela wamizi wa heye kwinjila mli lila ilundo, wamlavye Paoli na kumhilusa mgati mwa ngome.
Mihe yizile, mkulu nakema behi na Paoli, nakamlonjela, “Uleche kudumba! Kunhawiza hano Yelusalemu, kodita hihyo na mujini Loma.”
Wayahudi wangugongomanya kumkopola Paoli
Lokuchele, Wayahudi nawadita nhing'hano ya uyeka. Welaha, “Hatulya na hatunwa mbaka hotuwa tumkopole Paoli.”
Wanhu wahejile makumi gane ndo waganile chiuviso kudita ahyo.
Hamba nawaluta kwa watambika wakulu na wasekulu, wolonga, “Hetwe tilaha kuta hatujeza choneche kuli mimelo ja hetwe mbaka aho hotuwa tumkopole Paoli.
Lelo hemwe hamwe na watagusa galeni usenga kwa mkulu wa wamizi leka yamigale Paoli kuli hemwe mchivilizila mwangugana kuvizela ng'hatu mbuli za heye. Natukunda kumkopola hanafika habehi.”
Ila mwana wa lumbulye Paoli nakahulika ago gowolongasa, ahyo nakaluta mgati mwa ngome, nakamlonjela Paoli mbuli ayo.
Aho Paoli kamchema mwamizi yumwe, nakamlonjela, “Mhole ayu msongolo lute na heye kwa mkulu wa wamizi, kana chinhu cha kukulonjela.”
Mwamizi nakamhola ayo msongolo, kaluta naye kwa mkulu wa wamizi, kalonga, “Yula mnweng'hwa Paoli kanyhema kandanda ndimgale ayu msongolo kwa hegwe mina kana chinhu cha kukulonjela.”
Mkulu wa wamizi kambata ayo msongolo moko, kamgala honhu ha uyeka, nakamuuza, “Kuna choni cha kundonjela?”
Heye nakalonga, “Wayahudi wahadana wakulande umgale Paoli muutaguso wochivilizila kuta watagusa wangugana kuvizela mbuli zitanganiche ng'hatu za heye.
Ila hegwe uleche kukunda mina hana wanhu makumi gane wekale goya kumvada. Welaha kuleka kulya ne kunwa chinhu mbaka howowa wamkopole. Sambi mina wa goya, wangubeteza ukundizo wa hegwe.”
Mkulu wa wamizi nakamlonjela, “Uleche kumlonjela munhu yoneche kuta hegwe kungalila mbuli azo.” Hamba nakamleka yalute.
Paoli kangigaligwa kwa chilongozi wa mkowa

Mkulu wa wamizi nakawachema wamizi weli kawalonjela, “Wicheni wamizi miya mbili na wakwina falasi makumi saba na wamizi miya mbili wa migoha, walute Kaisaliya. Migongomanye kuka hala hainafika saa tatu lelo hano hamihe.
Muwiche falasi wamwe awo kwa Paoli, mhiliche goya kwa Felisi chilongozi wa mkowa.”
Hamba ayo mkulu wa mkowa nakandika ahi.
“Heni Klaudiyo Lusia ndangukwandichila hegwe mkulu Felisi, chilongozi wa mkowa. Ulamche chilongozi!
Wayahudi nawamibata munhu yumwe hachefu tele wamkopole. Wone nandeche kulonga kuta heye munhu wa Loma. Ahyo nanduta hamwe na wamizi ndimlohola.
Nandimhilika kumwando kwa watagusa wa hewo wakulu ndilapa ndivizele chila chimuwalile hewo wamtaguse.
Nandivizela kuta kutagusa ako kwali gali gala ga kuwala honhu hamwe ha malajizo ga hewo na ahyo sonile kuta kadita choneche chilingumwambuza yakopoligwe ama yawohigwe mchinweng'ho.
Londonjelwe kuta Wayahudi wali waditile chiuviso kumkopola, nangana kumgala kwa hegwe, ndiwalonjela wataguswa wa heye wegale utaguso wa hewo kwa hegwe.”
Awo wamizi nawamhola Paoli kota vyowalonjelwe, wamgala hamihe yiyila mbaka Antipatili.
Mitondo wamizi wa magulu wahiluka kuli ngome, wawaleka wala wamizi wakwina falasi walutilile na majendo ga hewo hamwe na Paoli.
Lowafichile Kaisaliya nawampa mkulu wa mkowa gala maandiko na kumuwika Paoli hasi ha ulongozi wa heye.
Felisi loyasomile ago maandiko nakamuuza kulawila mkowa wachi? Loyalonjelwe kuta nayali yalawile mkowa wa Kilikiya,
kalonga, “Ndohulichiza nongwa ya hegwe wone wawele na nongwa wafiche.” Hamba nakalonga Paoli yawichigwe hasi ha udimi mng'handa ya undewa wa Helodi.
